labels.name: Debt collection
labels.description: Attempts to collect a debt: collection calls or letters, debts the customer says are not theirs or already paid, threats or harassment, requests to validate a debt.

labels.name: Bank accounts
labels.description: Checking or savings accounts: opening or closing accounts, deposits and withdrawals, overdraft and account fees, frozen accounts, unauthorized transactions on a bank account.

labels.name: Credit and prepaid cards
labels.description: Credit cards or prepaid cards: charges on a statement, card fees and interest, purchase disputes and chargebacks, rewards, card applications or closures.

labels.name: Money transfers and digital payments
labels.description: Payment apps, wire transfers, digital wallets, virtual currency and money orders: sending or receiving money, missing or fraudulent transfers, access to payment app accounts.

labels.name: Mortgages
labels.description: Home loans: applying, servicing and escrow, mortgage payments, loan modification, foreclosure, closing, home equity loans.

labels.name: Student loans
labels.description: Federal or private student loans: repayment plans, servicer problems, forgiveness or discharge, payment application, default.

labels.name: Auto and personal loans
labels.description: Vehicle loans or leases, payday loans, title loans, personal loans and advance loans: payments, repossession, loan terms, fees and interest.

labels.name: Credit reports and credit repair
labels.description: Errors or disputes on credit reports, identity theft appearing on a credit report, improper use of a report, credit monitoring, credit repair or debt settlement services.
